test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the dice that can be formed by folding the given sheet along the lines.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97061207079cd57103dfac5865dfba789fe2acde2f7926b6065034662a49b2a2.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a06a5fc2680f13157c7575ea0e0c9b8a244400e285bdaf740ddd80a72915a22a.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is: 

The opposite surface of the open dice can be found by the below method:-

__
 
• Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other.
 
• No two opposite surfaces are touched by side or by corners

So, by using the above rule we can find the opposite surface of open dice.

In the given figure, Opposite faces are :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee61c8cd818de7d324797fa713f69ebf9d2bcb6e72cdd858d92c4a6798d7d3e6.png] 

1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7970e82ab3396435057e30021b1a66e12917410f8180d740140e519525136cda.png] → **All three sides are adjacent to each other.**

2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ba76b76afb6c75508dbd60cdf313fe124775db9cea00e9d360b5a170364f754.png] → the sequence of 2 - 4 - 5 is anti-clockwise in the question dice but in the fig. (B), it is clockwise.

3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a74d8d2fd379bcf10ec69c8e947a887b3809f424a07a0e368c316c87a4a084e.png] → The two sides should be opposite to each other but given adjacent to each other.

4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f2067aef3d1cef38ba4c877b292083d059abd101092fea6ba1f94c668bfed73.png] → **All three sides are adjacent to each other.**

**∴** Here, dice A, and D are formed by folding the given sheet along lines.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only A and D".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07576b149cd791c84e25c0eb52e318eab150e889d757f69971133fa00315d179.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4740e62e37a8c6b9f83d6aef68e5d9aeb2a358d1ff5f302a394e0259a413476c.png] 

**The sequence of 2 - 4 - 5 is anti-clockwise in the question dice but it is clockwise in the open dice of fig. (B).**
